scope: TH2 D/C paired residual mechanism predictions
source: Only authorized N1c GOOD residual quantiles, A8 K<=4 class/ranks, and planner-confirmed native solver settings
theory_assumptions: locally linear A and flat prior along rank-r identifiable subspace
exact posterior draw under an over-weighted Gaussian data term; not proved for deployed finite-step samplers
identity: Delta=chi2_r/kappa - independent_chi2_r; all three expectations follow from d/sigma=PZ+Pxi/sqrt(kappa)

model_conditional_predictions.basis: flat locally Gaussian sampler hypothesis, not direct native theorem

model_conditional_predictions.caveat: native additional Euler SSE-gradient step breaks simple kappa proxy

model_conditional_predictions.Delta_sign: nonnegative if measurement-noise coupling is negligible
model_conditional_predictions.caveat: denoiser output depends on y; C=0 is an empirical mechanism hypothesis, not guaranteed

diagnostic_tests: A5.5 may reject the surrogate if DAPS/SITCOM have C near zero rather than positive, or observed Delta sign is predominantly positive
test conditional D/C differences for GOOD vs CONSISTENT and ORBIT, not just marginal median residual
G and a strictly rotated G have identical D,C; measured G/O ranking leak comes from differing generated off-orbit perturbations

orientation_leak_pred.DAPS: G residual lower than O in majority of independent generated G/O comparisons, as in A8; difference sign determined by (D_O-D_G)-2(C_O-C_G)
orientation_leak_pred.FAST: G lower than O in majority, hypothesis independent of deterministic exact orbit identity

uncertainty: actual r not measured; r/m inferred from medians is illustrative only
posterior temperature approximation may not describe finite-step solvers
class-rank comparisons share images and are not independent
abstentions: no quantitative A5.5 D/C observed value assumed
no per-class CONSISTENT magnitude or rate forecast absent mechanistic evidence
no use of XP return, forbidden K>4, or A5.5 outcomes
